The Grimrail is an armored train that was built by Pauli Rocketspark for the needs of the Iron Horde supply and crew transportation, that is cruising throughout Gorgrond from Grimrail Depot. At the end of the dungeon, the Grimrail crashes into a canyon, named in-game as Grimrail Crash Site. The rails also connect to the Foundry Terminus and the Iron Docks. At least two more Grimrail locomotives were built by the Mag'har Clans after their liberation. Their rails go from Hellsreach Citadel to the Blackrock Foundry and Grimrail Depot.
Grimoire Of Convert Demon is the warlock class tome found in Ashran.

The Grimfrost clan is a small clan of ogres led by Guttra Wolfchew that inhabit Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge. They have recently skirmished with outriders of the Frostwolf clan, led by Outrider Urukag. They've a great hatred for the Frostwolf clan's frost wolves, as they can be found captured, dead, and partially eaten all over Grimfrost Hill. The Grimfrost, or at least a small faction of them led by the Grimfrost Wormpriest, also seem to worship the giant lava worm Borrok the Devourer, and will feed him sacrifices when he emerges. The ogres regularly rob Frostwolf orcs and offer them as sacrifices to Borrok.
Grimfrost Hill is a Grimfrost ogre village in eastern Frostfire Ridge. From here these ogres worship a creature at the Pit of the Devourer and have been capturing frostwolves from the Frostwolf clan.
The Grimrail Enforcers is the second boss of the Iron Docks.
Grinfel Frostfinger is a forsaken follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Grimrail Technicians are goblins located at the Train Depot inside Grimrail Depot.
Gripping Shadows are summoned by doomguard bosses during the Legion Invasions. It will occasionally pull all nearby players into it, dealing shadow damage until they escape.
Grinning Shadowstalkers are felstalkers that appear during the battle for the Broken Shore and during the assault on Broken Shore.
Grimrot is a bear located at the Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

The gronn are a race of immense, brutal giants native to Draenor. They are members of the Breaker faction, descendants of the magnaron and the ancient colossals and are themselves the ancestors of the ogron, ogres and orcs, the former of which worshipped their massive progenitors as gods. However, the gronn show little love for their ogre offspring, ruling over the ogre clans of Outland with an iron fist. Adolescent gronn are known as gronnlings.

The Grizzly Hills, located in southeastern Northrend, is a forested area, surrounded by the Howling Fjord to the south, the Dragonblight to the west and Zul'Drak to the north. It is the homeland of the Grizzlemaw furbolgs. Many furbolgs live in this region, most in the large settlement of Grizzlemaw. Both the dwarven settlement of Thor Modan and the Ice troll fortress of Drak'Tharon Keep, now occupied by the Scourge, can be found in the north. The hills are home to an independent population of humans simply called the "trappers", whose signature trading posts can be found throughout the region. When a player enters the Ring of Law in the Depths, an arena event will occur where players have to face three waves of non-elite enemies and finally an elite mini-boss. Grizzle is one of six possible mini-bosses that could appear. The other ones are Anub'shiah, Eviscerator, Gorosh the Dervish, Hedrum the Creeper, and Ok'thor the Breaker.

Grol'dom Farm is one of the many orcish pig farms that have sprung up in the years after the founding of Orgrimmar. It was originally inhabited by only Kranal Fiss and his children, but since the Cataclysm it has grown into a stopping point for caravans traveling between Orgrimmar and Crossroads. The farm is under constant attack from Razormane Pillagers. The farm serves as a quest hub, with an innkeeper, stable master, and repairs. Here, adventurers will first meet Mankrik and can pay their respects at the Humble Monument, a memorial to Mankrik's deceased wife, Olgra. During the Burning Legion's invasions, the farm was assaulted by the Legion, leaving the area in turmoil. The swines special

The Grizzled Den is a rather large cave system just southwest of Kharanos in Dun Morogh, where young adventurers can test their mettle against the ferocious wendigos which live there. Many enter in search of wendigo manes, which are popular for use in seat covers, but it is a risky proposition as the monsters breathe frost spells and flock together to drive the assailants out. Some special finds in the cave system are copper veins and treasure chests. Also, there is a rare wendigo in the back that is a bit tougher than its counterparts. The Grom'arsh Crash-Site can be found to the east of the Temple of Storms, southeast of the Snowdrift Plains, west of the Terrace of the Makers, and north of the Engine of the Makers within the Storm Peaks. It is an encampment made of the wreck of a goblin zeppelin, utilized by the Horde when events were heating up in Ulduar. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that camp is fully abandoned, though the wreckage of the airship can still be seen, peeping out of the ice.

Grookin Hill is a hozen village found just west of Tigers' Wood, past the Slicky Stream in western Jade Forest. This is the main village of the Forest Hozen, where the big chief resides. After gaining favor with the hozen, by killing the mean wikkets (the Alliance who were killing them), killing a hozen-killing tiger, and gathering bait to catch fish, the chief decides to fight alongside the good wikkets (the Horde). When the signal flare is lit by the adventurer, the surviving Horde attack force make their way from the Strongarm Airstrip to here as their new temporary base of operations.

Gronnlings are adolescent gronn. Once "befriended", a gronnling will happily carry its rider to their death. Gronnling scales are more like stones than true scales, as the brutes themselves seem to be part stone. Alchemists have been known to show an interest in digging up gronnling bones for research purposes.

Grom'kar Vanguards are orcs located in Mor'gran Logworks, Tuurem and in Talador. They also attack The Lunarfall and Frostwall garrisons.
Grom'kar Shadowblades are orcs located in Mor'gran Logworks, Tuurem, and in Talador.
Grom'kar Siegesmiths are orcs located in Archenon Siegeyard in Talador.
Gronn Pulverizers are gronns found in the Molten Quarry in Ashran. These elite patrolling mobs pack quite a punch, so try to keep track of their movements while adventuring in the Quarry.
Gronnling Breakers are hostile gronnlings found in the Molten Quarry in Ashran.

Grommashar is the base of the on , located on the south-east coast of , between and Mar'gok's Overwatch. It is a well-defended fortress, from which the Warsong clan dominate the eastern half of Nagrand. It is named for , chieftain of the Warsong clan. The entrance is called the Gates of Grommashar. There is a throne area where a tree, the one Grommash had been tied to may years ago, was moved. On the tree is the skull of a former Imperator.
Gronnling Bonebreakers are gronnlings located at Affliction Ridge in Gorgrond.
Grom'kar Grunts are orcs located at Crushfang's End in Gorgrond.
Grom'kar Captives are orcs located at the Fissure of Fury in Gorgrond.
Grom'kar Pyros are orcs located in Gorgrond. They are fighting Char the Burning.
__NOTOC__ Grogal the Harvester is an orc found in Gul'var of .
Grommloc is a -themed companion that can be obtained from the BlizzCon 2014 swag/goodie bag.

The Grom'kar are hardened orcs of the various clans of the Iron Horde and some of the best warriors they have to offer. They were led by until his death, after which they fell under Azuka Bladefury's authority at Bladefury's Command. The Grom'kar forces can be found throughout most of , most notably Gorgrond and Talador as well as in Tanaan Jungle. They appear to make up the main army of the Iron Horde.

The mighty Chieftain of the Warsong clan is as ferocious as his battle cry. Hellscream has long waited to venture into Azeroth and prove the dominance of the Warsong clan on the field of battle. Although Grom distrusts the shaman Ner'zhul, he will lead his clan screaming onto the fields of bloody death.

Grizzlesnout's Fang is an item that transforms you into a black worg and races you forward at 250% running speed for 15 seconds, a somewhat similar effect to the Skull of the Mad Chief. It is apparently supposed to be from or named after Grizzlesnout.
Grom'tash the Destructor is an orc located at the Congregation of Souls in .
Gronn-Tooth Necklace is a common Draenor Clans archaeology artifact, created from 55 Draenor Clans Archaeology Fragments. One Draenor Clan Orator Cane may be used to solve this artifact.

Gronn Canyon is a valley near central Gorgrond, where Drov the Ruiner can be found. The central parts of the canyon are known as the Valley of Destruction. Gro the Uncreator can be found roaming both the canyon and the valley. The Fissure of Fury can be found to the south, bordering Drywind Gorge. Brak's Excavation can be found in the north-western part of the canyon. To the far north, the canyon borders the Pit. South of the Pit, Rolkor has trashed a Grom'kar camp, now littered with the corpses of grunts and shieldbearers.
Grom'kar Dispatch is found on the Grom'kar Messenger Corpse in Gorgrond.
The Grizzly Hills Gatewardens are dryads found at the gate to the Grizzly Hills in the Emerald Dreamway.
Grizzleweald is a Grizzleweald furbolg village found in Val'sharah. The village is currently under attacked by grells.
Grobble is a wyrmtongue that appears in several places during the Legion Invasions. He can summon Brittlebone Skeletons.

Grol'dom Grunt are guards that protects Grol'dom Farm from the invading Razormane. They can be seen fighting with axes and rifles, and some of them were injured during their duty. They were present during the Legion Invasions.
Grisly Schism drops from Mana Devourer in Return to Karazhan.
Grookin Furrymasters are hozen located in Grookin Hill of the Jade Forest shortly before the battle at the Serpent's Heart.

Grond was a massive elemental giant created by the titan Aggramar to defeat the Evergrowth and then maintain balance over primal Draenor. Upon being slain by the Sporemound Botaan, Grond's body fell and became the region of Gorgrond, while his head in Nagrand became known as the Throne of the Elements. The boulders that toppled from his body during his clash with the Sporemounds gave rise to the colossals and in turn their descendants—the various breakers, the ogres, and the orcs—while the elemental energies contained in the debris gave rise to Draenor's first physical elementals.
Grongo is a hobgoblin located at the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles.
Grolethax is a terrorguard located at the Well of Eternity in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Grom'kar Sharpshooters are orcs located at the in Talador. They ride Grom'kar Warbeasts.
Grom'kar Warbeasts were clefthooves located at the in Talador. They were ridden by Grom'kar Sharpshooter.
Grol'dom Net is provided as an objective for Drag it Out of Them. Given by Togrik, it is used to capture a Razormane Pillager.
Grom'kar Deadeyes are orcs found in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge. Some of them shoot at a Ironwing Flamespitter.
Grom'kar Warsmiths are orcs located in Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Grom'kar Warforgers are orcs located in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge. They can be seen working on siege machines and anvils.
Grom'kar War Rylaks are rylaks located in Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle. They are mounted by Grom'kar War Riders.
Grom'kar Technicians are orcs located in Iron Docks. They are armed with a bottle of slippery grease.
Grom'kar Snipers are orcs that attack the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.
Grom'kar Skirmishers are orcs located in Path of Glory in Talador.
Grom'kar Siegebreakers are orcs located in Path of Glory in Talador.
Grom'kar Shocktroopers are orcs located in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Grom'kar Shieldbearers are orcs located in attacking Karabor. They also appeared in Gorgrond.
Grom'kar Sentries are orcs located in Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
The Grom'kar Scout Sniper is a dead orc lying in the Valley of Destruction in Gorgrond with his head crushed by a giant boulder. The Spy's Logbook and Sniper's Crossbow can be found at a camp nearby.
Grom'kar Reinforcements are orcs located in Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle. They originally appeared at the in Talador.
Grom'kar Punishers are orcs located in in Talador. They later appeared in Tanaan Jungle.
Grom'kar Pulverizers are siegemakers located in Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge. They are piloted by Iron Machinists.
Grom'kar Leadslingers are orcs located in Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.

Grom'kar Enforcers are orcs located in Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Grom'kar Dockhands are orcs located in Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Grom'kar Cripplers are dire orcs located in the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge. Several of them are locked in cages.
Grom'kar Commanders are orcs located in Frostwall and Lunarfall during invasions.
Grom'kar Cauterizers are orcs located in Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Grom'kar Bulwarks are orcs located in Talador and Tanaan Jungle.
Grom'kar Assault Rylak was a rylak located in the Iron Siegeworks and taken out by the followers sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
Gritslime Snails are snails located in the instanced and uninstanced version of Eye of Azshara.
Gronn Treeslammers were gronns located in Gorgrond that were taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.
